name: GIN-Dock-Wallpaper
description: Unified Smart Hot-Corner Dock Bar & 4K Wallpaper Calendar HUD Engine for Windows 10/11
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev & Antigravity
features: Unified Dock + Dynamic 4K Wallpaper: Seamless integration of hot-corner app dock and 4K wallpaper calendar engine
Independent Feature Toggles: Freely enable/disable Dock bar or Wallpaper engine based on user preference
Top or Left Placement: Choose between sliding down from screen top or sliding right from screen left
Clean Minimalist Brand Button: Removed extraneous left arrow icon next to GIN logo for an uncluttered modern UI
Dual Font Size Controls: Independent font size sliders for Folders (7-16 pt) and open items/app icons (7-16 pt)
Flexible Sorting Options: Alphabetical (A-Z, default), Reverse (Z-A), Folders First, File Type, and Date Modified

12 Signature Color Themes: Warm Sand (Default), Midnight OLED, Cyberpunk Amber, Nordic Frost, Emerald Forest, Deep Space Navy, Solarized Desert, Tokyo Neon, Pure Glass, Rose Gold, Titanium, and Daylight Light
Day / Night Mode: Toggle between Daylight and Dark styles, or auto-sync with Windows system dark theme
12-Language Multilingual Localization: English (default), Russian, Czech, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Ukrainian, Chinese, and Japanese
Curated 4K Wallpaper Engine: Official Wallhaven API integration with 8 curated categories and high-definition Unsplash fallback
Anti-Aliased Live Calendar HUD: Real-time desktop calendar overlay with current date highlighting and day/night theme matching
Single Sand-Colored 'G' Tray Icon: Unified custom icon across application, tray, installer, and uninstaller
Dedicated Uninstaller: Full Uninstall.exe and uninstall.cmd inside install directory with clean registry/shortcut cleanup
Ultra-Low Memory Footprint: Native WinAPI/GDI+ architecture idling at ~2-4 MB RAM with automatic memory trimming
